req.title: Status code sentence body
req.statement: The system shall include the standard reason phrase in the body when responding to /status/<code> with a code between 400 and 599.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return the standard reason phrase in the body for status codes between 400 and 599. This test suite will verify that behavior by checking positive, negative, and boundary cases. The positive case will check a typical client error, the negative case will check an invalid status code, and the boundary case will check the edge of the specified range.

tests.name: test_status_code_404
preconditions: The server is running and accessible.
expected: The response body contains the reason phrase 'Not Found'.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/status/404')
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.data.decode() == 'Not Found'

tests.name: test_status_code_invalid
preconditions: The server is running and accessible.
expected: The response body contains the message 'Invalid status code'.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/status/invalid')
